title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Due Date of a Renewal's Missing-Information Notice
content:
**Clause.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), for the missing-information notice of a renewal application, and only for such a notice, the documents due date is the notice date plus the response days worked out as stated here, counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice date; every other missing-information notice keeps a documents due date of the notice date plus the tier's missing-information response days, in calendar days. The response days of a renewal's notice are the tier's missing-information response days, a whole number of calendar days.

**Hypothetical dates (response days taken as 30).**

| Notice date | Day 1 | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| 2030-05-10 | 2030-05-11 | 2030-06-09 |
| 2030-12-15 | 2030-12-16 | 2031-01-14 |
